scopes.required_scope: Reportable suspicious activity and applicable conditions; identifier references alone are insufficient.
Initial-detection deadline plus relevant extension/conditions.
Currency threshold, transactions covered and aggregation condition.
Identify/verify beneficial owners, ownership/control prongs and applicable scope.
Exact filing key term requested by the named advisory; corroboration separately classified.
Exact key term requested by the named check-fraud alert.
Ransomware filing key term under the named advisory.
Aggregate blocked ownership threshold and direct/indirect ownership scope.
Permitted information sharing, purpose and participation safeguards.
Correspondent-account due diligence and risk-based requirements.
PEP identification, approval, source-of-funds/wealth and monitoring obligations as applicable.
Travel-rule application to VASPs, required information and relevant conditions.
Program pillars and their substance, including any applicable CDD obligation.
Observable caregiver theft indicators, beyond topical elder-fraud mention.
Indicators of alteration/deposit of stolen checks.
Financial indicators of human trafficking with relevant contextual limitations.
Persuasion/recruitment mechanics of fraudulent crypto investment schemes.
Bank-observable indicators of AI-generated identity imagery.
Risk-based monitoring intensity and updating based on customer risk.
Response when beneficial-owner identity cannot be verified, including policy-based actions.
Maritime methods concealing cargo origin and their mechanism.
Concrete sanctions compliance controls for virtual-currency businesses.
Sham ownership transfers and retained beneficial control mechanisms.
Who may test AND how independence is maintained; record any missing facet.
How professional laundering services are marketed, including channels.
CRE features linking foreign buyers/opaque structures to laundering exposure.
Ransomware SAR key term AND filing deadline, preserving conditions.
OFAC blocked-property reporting deadline AND SAR deadline, distinguishing day units.
Elder-exploitation red flags AND perpetrator findings from BSA reports.
Mail-theft check-fraud filing trend AND actionable red flags; distinguish report populations.
Ongoing monitoring, updating information and risk-based duties beyond initial identification.
Risk described in the historical citizenship-program advisory AND mitigation; adjudicate historical scope.
